chunks: Al-Hasan ibn 'Abdillah ibn Muḥammad ibn 'Īsā narrated to me from his father, from al-Hasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Juwayriyah ibn al-'Alā', from some of our companions, who said:

Whoever desires that he may look at Allāh on the Day of Judgment, and that the agony of death and the terror of the emergence [from the grave] may be made easy for him, let him increase in visiting the grave of al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him). Verily, visiting al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) is visiting the Messenger of Allāh (peace be upon him).

key_terms.سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ: The agony or stupor of death
key_terms.هَوْلُ الْمُطَّلَعِ: The terror of the emergence (from the grave)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this tradition to establish the ontological link between the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophet, asserting that visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn is equivalent to visiting the Messenger of Allāh. This practice serves as a means of spiritual intercession, alleviating the 'sukrat al-mawt' (agony of death) and the 'hawl al-mutalla' (awe of the Divine Presence) on the Day of Judgment. The promise of beholding Allāh highlights the unique status of the Imams as the ultimate proofs (hujaj) through whom believers attain nearness to the Divine.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Ḥasan ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā narrated to me from his father, from Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Juwayriyah ibn ‘Alā, from some of our companions, who said: (Imam Sādiq (a.s.) said):

Those who want their struggle at the time of death to be made easy for them, those who want their fear for that which is coming (Judgment) to be reduced, and those who want to be able to look at Allāh on the Day of Judgment, should increasingly go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Verily the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) is the Ziyārah of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.).
